def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = 168
    k = 6
    
    # Create a list of people (1-indexed, but we'll use 0-indexed internally)
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    current_idx = 0
    
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Count k people and eliminate the k-th one
        current_idx = (current_idx + k - 1) % len(people)
        people.pop(current_idx)
        # After removal, current_idx already points to the next person
        # (or wraps around if we removed the last one)
        if current_idx >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_idx = current_idx % len(people)
    
    return float(people[0])
